name: TOTP Enrollment
description: Presents the authenticator enrollment QR code and secret before the user confirms the generated verification code.

mobile.notes: Mobile renders the staged otpauth URI locally as a scannable QR code, displays the setup secret, and provides optional Advanced actions to open the otpauth URI in a registered authenticator app or copy the setup key.

notes: The runtime inventory represented the QR code and secret as unknown fields. The canonical contract models them as non-input display controls.
The prior action id 'next' is normalized to the semantic action id 'continue'.
This view is operation-free; begin-enrollment errors belong to auth.mfa.totp.start.
Advanced convenience actions do not alter the enrollment ceremony: open-authenticator launches the local otpauth URI and copy-secret copies the setup key without any additional server operation.
